description.value: Basecamp Resorts Revelstoke is a boutique suite hotel on the north edge of Revelstoke, offering modern multi-bedroom suites with views of the Columbia River and a riverside hot tub. Part of the Basecamp Resorts mountain chain, the property positions itself as a launchpad for outdoor adventure including skiing, biking, and paddling. Room configurations range from micro studios to six-bedroom suites, making it a flexible option for solo cyclists and group tours alike.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Basecamp Resorts Revelstoke is a real, operating boutique suite hotel on Highway 23 North near downtown Revelstoke, with active room listings and booking functionality. The site explicitly mentions biking as an activity ('ski, bike, paddle') and describes itself as a launchpad for outdoor adventure, but provides no specific evidence of bike storage, staff bike procedures, or any of the optional amenities. The website's displayed phone (+1 855-219-4707) and email (stay@basecampresorts.com) differ from the OSM tags, likely reflecting corporate vs. property-level contact details.
